stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Parse the stated regular-expression grammar into a Thompson epsilon NFA, stripping only the outer clue anchors so alternation remains fully anchored. Epsilon closures handle nested stars and empty matches without recursive matching loops. For each row or column constraint, compute forward reachable NFA sets under current cell-letter domains, then a backward pass identifies exactly which letters at every position lie on an accepting path of the required length. Propagate unsupported-letter removals between rows and columns. Backtrack on the smallest remaining cell domain, stopping after two distinct complete boards. Zero solutions yields none, two yields ambiguous, and exactly one yields that board. This counts distinct crossword assignments rather than NFA parse paths, so regex ambiguity does not become false puzzle ambiguity.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
stdio_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
